To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the energy consumption in EBFGT may be reduced by proper design of the reactor.

(1) the multistage irradiated reactors are more energy-efficient, but (2) the multistages reactors with interstage mixing are even more energy-efficient, and (3) the mixing conditions in the reactor play an important role in energy efficiency of the multistage reactors.

(i) multistage irradiations with interstage mixing may improve the efficiency of EBFGT, (ii) the mixing conditions have an influence on NOx removal and (iii) the reactor construction should be modified to improve energy efficiency of EBFG.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a novel approach to EBFGT reactor design and operation.
the analysis of the impact of the number and arrangement of stages on energy efficiency of the EBFGT process.
a new concept of the reactor construction for the electron beam flues gases treatment.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the energy efficiency of electron beam flues gas treatment process may be improved by means of multistage radiation and mixing.
the multistage irradiations and interstage mixing is an effective method to increase NOx removal efficiency and reduce energy consumption.
the multistage irradiations and proper mixing conditions may reduce the energy costs of the process and improve the process efficiency in general.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
mixing of flue gas in the reactor and multistage treatment may be a good strategy to increase energy efficiency of electron beam flug gas treatment.
the energy consumption of the EBFGT process can be reduced by 25% by applying two-stage irradiation and proper construction of the mixing zone.
multistage irradiations are more effective than a one-stage process.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the mixing conditions and multieffect irradiation may significantly increase the efficiency of the process.
multistage irradiations with proper mixing conditions may improve the efficiency of EBFGT process.
proper design of the reactor may lead to significant reduction in energy consumption and increase the process efficiency.
